Moderna.why: Biopharma customer of Tempus AI: Tempus collects and transfers tumor tissue and blood samples for NGS and, subject to regulatory approvals, provides NGS services for the design and manufacture of intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), the individualized neoantigen therapy Moderna co-develops with Merck & Co. Same role as the existing 'Biopharma End Customers' (Bristol Myers Squibb, Eli Lilly, AstraZeneca). Identity: SEC company_tickers / submissions - 'Moderna, Inc.', CIK 1682852, Nasdaq MRNA. Not an existing node under another spelling.
Moderna.evidence: Tempus AI press release 10-07-2026: 'Tempus (NASDAQ: TEM) today announced an expanded, multi-year collaboration to support the potential commercialization of intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) ... Intismeran autogene is jointly developed by Moderna and Merck ... Tempus will manage the timely collection and transfer of tumor tissue and blood samples required for next-generation sequencing (NGS). Subject to applicable regulatory approvals, Tempus will also provide NGS services to support the intismeran autogene design and manufacturing process.'

Merck & Co..why: Biopharma customer of Tempus AI in the same collaboration (Merck co-develops intismeran autogene with Moderna and markets KEYTRUDA, the anti-PD-1 therapy it is combined with). Identity: SEC company_tickers / submissions - 'Merck & Co., Inc.', CIK 310158, NYSE MRK, Rahway NJ; the release says Merck is 'known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada'. Canonical name 'Merck & Co.' so it cannot merge with the existing node 'Merck KGaA' (XETRA MRK.DE, EMD Electronics), a different company.
